fields.place: Born at Madhavapura (Nadia); Simuliyā; Navadvīpa; Kusuma-sarovara (Vraja)
fields.guru: Śrīpāda Nandakiśora Gosvāmī, of Advaita's family (dīkṣā); veśa from Prāṇakṛṣṇa dāsa Bābājī; Śrī Rūpa dāsa Bābājī (śikṣā)
fields.notes: Son of Bholānātha Adhikārī and Pyārīsundarī; named Mahendra. Took veśa as Ambikā dāsa and ran the ākhaḍā of Simuliyā; studied in Navadvīpa; did bhajana at Kusuma-sarovara living on mādhukarī; built a temple of Śrī Madana-mohana (1917).

fields.name: Manohara dāsa (of Śrīnivāsa's family)
fields.works: Bengali translation of the Anurāgavallī (Vṛndāvana, 1618 Śaka); Śrī Rādhāramaṇa-rasa-sāgara (Vrajabhāṣā)
fields.notes: He belonged to the family of Śrīnivāsa and was the guru of Priyādāsa; disciple of Śrī Rāmaśaraṇa Caṭṭarāja of Vaigonkala. Also called Āula Manohara. The end of the life of Manohara dāsa Bābājī of Madhavapura (1847–1947), with his dates and books, was in this record and went to his own record (06-11-2026).
